Problem: Reverse a string
Common Trap: Strings are immutable so you cannot reverse in place

Problem: Check if a string is a palindrome
Key Idea: Compare s to s[::-1] or use two pointers
Common Trap: Forgetting to normalise case and strip non-alphanumerics

Problem: Count vowels in a string
Key Idea: Sum a membership test over a vowel set
Common Trap: Not lowercasing so uppercase vowels are missed

Problem: Check if two strings are anagrams
Common Trap: Sorting works but is O(n log n); ignoring spaces and case

Problem: Count character frequency
Common Trap: Reinventing Counter with a manual dict

Problem: Remove duplicate characters keeping order
Common Trap: Using a set alone destroys the original order

Problem: Find the first non-repeating character
Key Idea: Count first then scan in order
Common Trap: A nested loop makes it O(n^2)

Problem: Capitalise the first letter of each word
Common Trap: title() mangles apostrophes: "o'brien" becomes "O'Brien"

Problem: Count words in a sentence
Common Trap: split(' ') creates empty strings on double spaces

Problem: Reverse the word order in a sentence
Common Trap: Reversing characters instead of words

Problem: Check if a string contains only digits
Common Trap: isdigit is True for superscripts; negatives and decimals fail

Problem: Longest word in a sentence
Common Trap: Not handling the empty-string case

Problem: Remove all whitespace from a string
Common Trap: strip() only removes leading and trailing whitespace

Problem: Check if a string is a pangram
Key Idea: Compare the letter set to ascii_lowercase
Common Trap: Forgetting to filter out non-letters

Problem: Toggle the case of each character
Common Trap: Manual looping when a builtin exists

Problem: Factorial of a number
Common Trap: Recursion hits the stack limit; 0! is 1

Problem: Nth Fibonacci number
Common Trap: Naive recursion is O(2^n) and times out

Problem: Print the Fibonacci series up to n terms
Key Idea: Same rolling pair inside a loop
Common Trap: Off-by-one on how many terms to print

Problem: Check if a number is prime
Common Trap: Looping to n is too slow; 1 is not prime; handle n<2

Problem: Print all primes in an interval
Key Idea: Sieve of Eratosthenes for a range
Common Trap: Re-running an is_prime check per number is slower

Problem: Check if a number is an Armstrong number
Key Idea: Sum each digit to the power of the digit count
Common Trap: Hardcoding power 3 — it must equal the number of digits

Problem: Sum the digits of a number
Common Trap: Forgetting to handle negative input

Problem: Reverse the digits of a number
Common Trap: Losing the sign; trailing zeros disappear (120 to 21)

Problem: Check if a number is a palindrome
Common Trap: Negative numbers are never palindromes

Problem: Greatest common divisor (GCD)
Key Idea: Euclid: while b: a, b = b, a%b
Common Trap: Looping over all candidates instead of using Euclid

Problem: Least common multiple (LCM)
Common Trap: Integer division matters; a*b can be large

Problem: Check if a number is a perfect number
Key Idea: Sum proper divisors up to sqrt(n)
Common Trap: Including n itself in the divisor sum

Problem: Count the digits in a number
Common Trap: 0 has one digit not zero digits

Problem: Swap two numbers without a temp variable
Common Trap: Reaching for XOR when tuple unpacking is idiomatic

Problem: Check if a number is even or odd
Common Trap: n % 2 == 1 is False for negative odd numbers in Python

Problem: Find the largest of three numbers
Common Trap: Long if-elif chains instead of max

Problem: Multiplication table of a number
Common Trap: Range bounds excluding 10

Problem: Check if a number is a power of two
Common Trap: Forgetting the n > 0 guard — 0 passes the bit test

Problem: Sum of squares of the first n naturals
Common Trap: Floating division instead of integer division

Problem: Convert decimal to binary
Common Trap: Forgetting to strip the '0b' prefix

Problem: Check if a year is a leap year
Key Idea: Divisible by 4 and (not by 100 or by 400)
Common Trap: Omitting the 400 rule — 1900 is not a leap year

Problem: Simple and compound interest
Common Trap: Integer division truncating the rate

Problem: Sum all elements in a list
Common Trap: Manual accumulation loop when sum exists

Problem: Find the largest and smallest in a list
Common Trap: ValueError on an empty list

Problem: Find the second largest in a list
Key Idea: Single pass tracking the two best
Common Trap: sorted()[-2] fails when duplicates tie for largest

Problem: Reverse a list
Key Idea: lst[::-1] for a copy or lst.reverse() in place
Common Trap: reverse() returns None — a very common bug

Problem: Remove duplicates from a list
Common Trap: set() loses order; unhashable elements raise TypeError

Problem: Sort a list without using sort
Common Trap: Being unable to state why it is O(n^2)

Problem: Count element occurrences in a list
Common Trap: Calling .count in a loop makes it O(n^2)

Problem: Merge two sorted lists
Common Trap: Concatenating and re-sorting wastes the sorted input

Problem: Sum of even and odd numbers in a list
Common Trap: Negative-odd modulo behaviour in Python

Problem: Move all zeroes to the end
Common Trap: Building a new list when in-place is expected

Problem: Rotate a list by k positions
Common Trap: Not taking k modulo n when k > n

Problem: Find the intersection of two lists
Common Trap: Nested loops give O(n*m); output order is not guaranteed

Problem: Find missing numbers in a range
Common Trap: For exactly one missing use the n(n+1)/2 sum trick

Problem: Flatten a nested list
Key Idea: Nested comprehension or recursion for deep nesting
Common Trap: A comprehension only flattens one level deep

Problem: Check if a list is sorted
Key Idea: all(a <= b for a, b in zip(lst, lst[1:]))
Common Trap: Sorting a copy to compare is O(n log n)

Problem: Sum of a list of lists / matrix sum
Common Trap: Forgetting ragged rows

Problem: Cumulative sum of a list
Common Trap: Recomputing a prefix sum each step gives O(n^2)

Problem: Find all pairs summing to a target
Key Idea: Hash set of complements in one pass
Common Trap: Nested loops; double-counting a pair; reusing one element

Problem: Split a list into equal chunks
Key Idea: Slice in steps of size k
Common Trap: Dropping the short final chunk

Problem: Find the mode of a list
Common Trap: Ties for the mode are ambiguous — ask

Problem: Interchange the first and last elements
Common Trap: Failing on a single-element or empty list

Problem: Multiply all numbers in a list
Common Trap: Initialising the accumulator to 0 instead of 1

Problem: Find array leaders (greater than all to the right)
Key Idea: Scan right to left tracking the running max
Common Trap: Nested loops give O(n^2)

Problem: Merge two dictionaries
Common Trap: Later keys silently overwrite earlier ones

Problem: Sort a dictionary by value
Common Trap: Sorting keys instead of items

Problem: Invert a dictionary
Key Idea: {v: k for k, v in d.items()}
Common Trap: Duplicate values collapse and lose entries

Problem: Sum all values in a dictionary
Common Trap: Iterating keys and re-indexing needlessly

Problem: Find the key with the maximum value
Common Trap: max(d) returns the largest key not the max value

Problem: Group items by a property
Common Trap: KeyError from a plain dict without setdefault

Problem: Count word frequency in a text
Common Trap: Not normalising case or stripping punctuation

Problem: Check if two dictionaries are equal
Common Trap: Key order is irrelevant to equality

Problem: Remove a key safely
Common Trap: del raises KeyError when the key is absent

Problem: Nested dictionary access with a default
Common Trap: Chained [] raises KeyError or TypeError

Problem: Check for balanced parentheses
Key Idea: Stack; push openers and match closers
Common Trap: Not checking the stack is empty at the end

Problem: Implement a stack using a list
Key Idea: append and pop from the end
Common Trap: pop(0) is O(n) — that builds a queue not a stack

Problem: Implement a queue
Common Trap: list.pop(0) is O(n) per operation

Problem: Binary search in a sorted list
Common Trap: mid overflow style bugs; wrong loop bound (low <= high)

Problem: Linear search
Common Trap: Returning the value instead of the index

Problem: FizzBuzz
Common Trap: Testing 3 and 5 before 15 so 15 prints "Fizz"

Problem: Print a right-angled star triangle
Common Trap: Off-by-one in range bounds

Problem: Print a pyramid star pattern
Common Trap: Miscalculating the space count per row

Problem: Print an inverted star pattern
Common Trap: Reversed range bounds

Problem: Print Pascal's triangle
Key Idea: Each row from the previous row's pairwise sums
Common Trap: Mishandling the first and last 1 of each row

Problem: Read a file and count lines or words
Common Trap: Not using a with block; readlines() loads everything

Problem: Find the most frequent word in a large file
Common Trap: Reading the whole file into memory at once

Problem: Write a list to a file line by line
Common Trap: writelines does not add newline characters

Problem: Check if a number appears twice in a list
Key Idea: Track seen values in a set
Common Trap: Nested loops give O(n^2)

Problem: Check if all list elements are unique
Common Trap: Unhashable elements raise TypeError

Problem: Union and difference of two lists
Common Trap: Sets do not preserve order

Problem: Remove common elements between lists
Common Trap: Mutating a list while iterating it

Problem: Fibonacci with memoisation
Common Trap: Forgetting the cache leaves it exponential

Problem: Sum of digits recursively
Common Trap: Missing or wrong base case causes infinite recursion

Problem: Reverse a string recursively
Common Trap: Slicing per call makes it quadratic — mention it

Problem: Tower of Hanoi
Key Idea: Move n-1 aside then the base then back
Common Trap: Confusing the auxiliary and destination pegs

Problem: Power of a number (fast exponentiation)
Common Trap: Not handling a negative or zero exponent

Problem: Flatten a nested dictionary
Key Idea: Recurse and join keys with a separator
Common Trap: Not handling lists nested inside the dictionary

Problem: Bubble sort
Common Trap: No early exit when a pass makes no swaps

Problem: Insertion sort
Key Idea: Shift each element into its sorted position
Common Trap: Best case is O(n) on sorted input — say so

Problem: Selection sort
Common Trap: Claiming it is stable — it is not

Problem: Merge sort
Common Trap: Forgetting the O(n) auxiliary space

Problem: Quick sort
Key Idea: Partition around a pivot then recurse
Common Trap: Worst case is O(n^2) on sorted input with a bad pivot

Problem: Count set bits in a number
Common Trap: Not knowing the n & (n-1) trick

Problem: Find the single number in a list of pairs
Common Trap: Using a Counter when XOR is O(1) space
